items.question: How long does a custom piece take?
items.answer: We agree the timeline in writing with the quote, because it depends on the design and any stones. For a wedding set, our advice is to start about three months before the date.

items.question: Can you remake my old jewellery?
items.answer: Yes. The old piece is tested and weighed in front of you, and its gold value goes towards the new piece. Stones can be reused if they are sound.

items.question: Do I see the design before it is made?
items.answer: Yes. You approve the design before any gold is cast; ask whether yours will be shown as a sketch, a render or a model.

items.question: How is a custom piece priced?
items.answer: Gold weight at the rate on the day the design is confirmed, plus the making charge for the work involved, plus stones if any. We quote it in writing before starting.
